कुच् {vI.v} {c6c} P. (कुचति, कुचित)
1 To
utter a shrill cry (as a bird).
--2 To
go.
--3 To polish.
--4 To contract,
bend.
--5 To be contracted.
--6 To stop,
impede.
--7 To write or delineate.
--8
To mix, connect. {vII.v} {c1c} P., कुंच्
also (कोचति, कुंचति, कुंचित)
1 To
make crooked, bend or curve.
--2 To
move or go crookedly.
--3 To make
small, lessen.
--4 To shrink,
contract.
--5 To go to or towards.

कुचः [कुच्-क] The female breast,
a teat, nipple; अपि
वनांतरमल्पकुचांतरा

.
--Comp.
--अग्रं, --मुखं
a nipple.
--तटं, --तटी the slope of
the female breast, the breast, (तट
being स्वार्थे or meaningless).
--फलः
the pomegranate tree.

कूचः The female breast, especially
[]
that of a young or unmarried woman;
see कुच.

कुचित a.
1 Closed, contracted.
--2 Small, little.

कुचर a. (रा, --री f.)
1 Going
slowly, creeping.
--2 Detracting,
censorious.
--रः A fixed star.

कूचिका, कूची
1 A small brush
of hair, a pencil.
--2 A key.

कूचिका, कूची
1 A small brush
of hair, a pencil.
--2 A key.
